title: Dino Trail Explorer
hook: Change the habitat when the evidence tells us to.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: brief cue gap with percussion thinned
visualStyle: 3D preschool dinosaur explorer storybook, field-guide trail mood, bright foliage and rocks, safe friendly creatures, bold contours

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child following fossil and habitat evidence rather than live-animal fantasy
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written habitat placement with taxonomy boundaries
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: trace cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/track gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a friendly low tom echo with a brief whistle answer, never a realistic roar.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a friendly low tom echo with a brief whistle answer, never a realistic roar
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Dino Trail Explorer a habitat-and-trace walk: tracks, nests, bones, coastal/marine context and volcanic geology reveal where different animals lived; the song never places every prehistoric animal on one land trail.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows evidence through land, shore, and water contexts, with explicit route changes for pterosaurs and Mosasaurus.
semanticArc: marine/geologic context and return to trail
